To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) we have demonstrated separability of the charged Dirac equation in higher-dimensional weak rotating black hole spacetime; (ii) the separability is characterized by the existence a complete set of symmetry operators generated from a Killing-Yano tensor.
The Dirac equation in the weak field approximation of a higher-dimensional rotating black hole can be solved analytically.

(i) we have demonstrated that the Dirac equation is separable in weakly charged Kerr-NUT-(A)dS black hole spacetimes, and (ii) the existence of a separable solution of the Dirac equations is intrinsically characterized, in the sense that the separability is equivalent to the existence of a Killing-Yano tensor.
